local function lCvuyjyhEZAIl(str, pos)
    local b0 = IBNfOTALKdhKIgl(str, pos)
    local b1 = IBNfOTALKdhKIgl(str, pos + 1)
    local b2 = IBNfOTALKdhKIgl(str, pos + 2)
    local b3 = IBNfOTALKdhKIgl(str, pos + 3)

end
